units.rawText: Did I manage to fulfil my dreams by coming to Magrasea? Maybe, or maybe not... Hmmm, the truth is, I didn't really give the subject much thought.

units.rawText: While I've made a lot of friends during my adventures, I always end up talking to "Liuxing" whenever I'm bored.

units.rawText: The truth is, "Liuxing" doesn't actually respond when I talk to it, but it does wonders for relieving my stress. Why don't you pour your heart out to it, too? It might be a troublemaker, but it'll never say you talk too much.
